release_title: TopUp Net Gateway v1.0.9 (Reliable GitHub In-App Updater & Integrity Fix)
changelog:
- Fixed In-App Update Download Failures: Increased streaming timeouts, added internal cache storage & automatic fallback across direct GitHub and redirect endpoints.
- Verified APK Integrity Check: Validates downloaded package header before launching installer and accurately reports failed system downloads.
- Smooth Unknown Apps Permission Flow: Auto-resumes installation when returning from Android install permission settings.
- Includes Signed Webhooks, Durable SMS Queue & Rotated Signing Lineage.
